entities.name: Adolph II, Prince of Anhalt-Köthen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adolph II, Prince of Anhalt-Köthen, also Anhalt-Zerbst was a German prince of the House of Ascania and ruler of the principality of Anhalt-Köthen. A Roman Catholic Bishop of Merseburg, he remained until his death a staunch opponent of Martin Luther.
